title: STS42 Smoothies
tagline: Protect and monetize thinking process creators' intellectual property using web3.
description:
Allows creators of processes to claim ownership on the structure and content of their thinking templates:
- Mint them into NFTs.
- Compare them to other thinking templates using a variety of means.
- Claim infringement.
- Resolve dispute.
This is just a draft. Will add more later.
how_its_made:
We didn't have time to complete but here was the plan:

We change the code to work on user-provided json structures.
We added a contract to verify if an identical (for now; we have ideas for "similars" later) object was already submitted.
